turns.question: In what share of our customer calls on 1 and 2 October 2026 did the customer raise an objection?
turns.answer: About 33.3% (one in three) of the labelled customer calls on 1 and 2 October 2026 had an objection raised by the customer, per the model-derived Objection rate metric. Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
